title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Can we name the Baby Boy as "Afraz" is it correct and what is the meaning of Afraz? 1877 views Q. Is Faaz Ali Hassan right name or not please give me a suggestion for my nephew? His father’s name is Md Imtiyaz Ali. 1795 views Q. Keeping Name Mateen 3447 views Q. Asak Mufti Saheb, Thanks a lot for answering my question.Fatwa Id 10582,(Fatwa: 124/125=D/1429).You replied that :"You may keep any of the two names: Ahmad or Muhammad".I am sorry but the response is a bit unclear to me.Does that mean that Ahmed or Mohammad can be either first or the last name.If,they can also be the last name or middle names,Can I keep my son's first name after any other name?Like:Ayaan Ahmed or Ayaan Mohammad .I just want to make sure that "Ahmed or Mohammad" can be the last names or not?Can I keep the first name of my child by any other 99 names of Prophet Mohammad(P.B.U.H) as well? I would relly appreciate your response. Thanks for your patience. 3916 views Q. What is the meaning of ADI AND RAYYAN IS THIS BETTER OR NOT? 3022 views Q. ISLAMIC NAMES 3283 views Q. Names 1797 views Q. I have been blessed with a daughter. I am looking for some names. One name came to my mind Urooj fatima. Urooj is male name. So this name Uroj fatima is suitable for a girl or not? 2251 views Q. Assalsmuslekum, I want to know that my nephew's name is "ARSH".Its right to keep this name or we have to change the name.Please give the answer at the earliest. Shukriyaa, Allah Hafiz Zakir 1702 views Q. Please, forgive me if the question has been asked earlier. However, I tried to search for it and failed. My question is: Is it mandatory to change the name of the person who is converting to Islam? Just to breif you, the existing name of the person who will be entering into Islam in a short span of time has a name which is not a part of the other religion or their so called Idols? Please elaborate on it. 1869 views Q. I have a 3 year old daughter, I kept her name as Daania. Please tell whether this name is correct. Please suggest some good names if it is not correct. 2342 views Q. I am expecting a baby very soon. So I want to know whether it is permissible to keep the fathers name next to the childrens' name for e.g. Ammara Imran or Talha Imran 1942 views Q. Can we keep the name of girl as ‘Aleena Fatimah’? Please tell us the meaning of ‘Aleena’. Please suggest 2729 views Q. 1817 views Q. REGARDING NAME 1896 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 45068 Country: India Title: Name Meaning Question: My name is Mohammed Ismail Shariff. My daughter born on march 15th 2013, Islamic date is 3rd of Jumada I, timing 8:15 pm. My first daughter’s name is Ameena Fariyal and my wife’s name is Arshiya Sultna. I want to keep second daughter name Afiya Kulsum. Please suggest me right name. Answer ID: 45068 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 693/671/N=1434) Afiya Kulsum is a good name for girl, you may keep it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
